resolutions.description: Merge decisions and canonical label selections for each duplicate group

should_merge.description: Whether the duplicates should be merged (true) or kept separate (false)

canonical_label.description: Selected canonical label from the group (required if should_merge=true, empty string otherwise)

merged_class_id.description: ID of the class to use as representative (required if should_merge=true, empty string otherwise)

reason.description: Explanation for merge decision and label selection
